major_cooldowns.name: Light's Potential
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-pot before the pull with your other long buffs, then drink the next one as soon as Arcane Surge is ready again.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1236616 is the drink cast seen in all 5 sampled parses; 1230869 is the crafted item row with no casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Arcane Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown or into an add wave, then chain Arcane Barrage the moment Arcane Soul appears as its buff ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 365350; 365362 is the self buff and 453326 the Arcane Phoenix copy.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Coordinate it with your group, and send it right after Arcane Surge in the opener when the call is yours.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Marked talent_gated so a raid where another class provides lust does not read as a missed cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of the Magi
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it off the global while an Arcane Barrage or Prismatic Bolt is mid-air, pair every second one with Arcane Surge, and put it on the enemy that will survive all 12 seconds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 321507; 210824 is the enemy debuff the log carries.

major_cooldowns.name: Presence of Mind
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it after an Arcane Barrage when you have no Arcane Charges and Arcane Orb, Arcane Pulse and Touch of the Magi are all down.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 205025; not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip, and the guide keeps it out of the priority list.

major_cooldowns.name: Evocation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it only when you are out of mana with Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi both down and Surge more than 10 seconds away, and cancel it once you are back near full.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 12051; no casts in the sampled parses, so talent_gated keeps zero casts from reading as an error on a season where mana is a non-issue.

rule.description: Open Arcane Surge into Barrage, then Touch of the Magi
rule.action: Open with Arcane Surge, send Arcane Barrage, and drop Touch of the Magi while the Barrage is mid-air.

rule.description: Touch of the Magi right after Arcane Barrage
rule.action: Fire Touch of the Magi off the global right after an Arcane Barrage so the bolt lands inside it.

rule.description: Pair Touch of the Magi with Arcane Surge
rule.action: Hold Touch of the Magi when Arcane Surge is close to ready so the two go out together.
Spend Clearcasting on Arcane Missiles instead of hard casting Arcane Blast.

rule.description: Arcane Barrage every global during Arcane Soul
rule.action: Chain Arcane Barrage through the whole Arcane Soul window instead of filling with Arcane Blast.

rule.description: Spend Arcane Barrage at full Arcane Charges
rule.action: Cap your Arcane Charges with Arcane Blast or Arcane Orb before you send Arcane Barrage.

rule.description: Bank Arcane Salvo stacks before Arcane Barrage
rule.action: Stack Arcane Salvo with Arcane Missiles before you dump Arcane Barrage.

rule.description: Prismatic Bolt with Cumulative Power stacked
rule.action: Channel Arcane Missiles to stack Cumulative Power before you fire Prismatic Bolt.
Cast Arcane Intellect before you pull and refresh it any time it drops.
